newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks close off as CANTV disappoints.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks close off as CANTV disappoints.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed off as local investors continued to unwind long positions as a long expected CANTV -led rally failed to materialize for a second consecutive session, brokers said.
The market's index closed down 1.83 percent at 5,997.89 points as 22 shares fell, eight rose and seven closed flat. CANTV lost 68.00 bolivars, or 3.96 percent, to end at 1,648.00 bolivars.
"Investors took up long positions on expectations CANTV would surge, boosting the market. It didn't happen, so people are selling off," said Intervalores broker Guillermo Arisa.
Trade in CANTV topped 1.2 million shares, as a total 11.8 million shares traded worth four billion bolivars ($8.5 million). Tuesday's fall came on top of a 1.66 percent drop in the IBC index Monday.
"We'll have to see if at these new lower levels shares are attractive again to foreign investors," Arisa added.
Among leading shares, Electricidad de Caracas lost 9.50 bolivars to close at 511.00, Mavesa lost 8.00 bolivars to end at 140.50 and Sivensa lost 10.00 bolivars to 328.00.
